about: Findings of the Kubernetes scans accepted on purpose, each with its reason (#1438). check-scans.js fails on any other finding, and on an entry here that no longer matches anything. Kubescape: control + resources ([file:]Kind/namespace/name, * for any part). kube-bench: check number.

kubescape.reason: OpenShift chooses the uid and group itself (its restricted SCC); a fixed one would be refused there. The Kubernetes and k3s overlays name the image's (1000:1000).

A run pod's uid and group are the run image's (1000), runAsNonRoot is enforced and oscar-runs enforces the restricted Pod Security Standard. The dispatcher leaves them to the platform: pod mode runs on OpenShift too, which chooses them.

The server's and the runner's root file systems stay writable for now: the server and Bruno write outside the volumes, and each of those places must become a volume first (OSCAR - Server Hardening, 4.2). Every other container of OSCAR has a read-only root.
Both talk to the Kubernetes API by design: the dispatcher makes and removes the run Jobs and Secrets in oscar-runs, Alloy reads the oscar pods' logs. Every other pod of OSCAR mounts no token.
The same two accounts as C-0034, for the same reason: their tokens are what lets them do their work, each limited to one namespace by a Role.
The dispatcher removes the Jobs and Secrets it made when their run ends, in oscar-runs only (a Role, not a ClusterRole).
The dispatcher lists Secrets in oscar-runs only, to remove those a lost run left (by its own label, at its start); that namespace holds no Secret but the run Secrets it made.

kube-bench.reason: The benchmark reads the first start of the API server in k3s's log. A k3s moved from SQLite to etcd as the guide does (k3s guide, section 9; the CI does the same) first started without etcd. On etcd k3s sets both arguments: the CI checks that the latest start names them.

k3s's own pods (CoreDNS, Traefik, metrics-server, the volume provisioner) need their tokens, and k3s writes their manifests. OSCAR's pods are Kubescape's C-0034 to check, where only the dispatcher and Alloy mount one.
